_help: Replace every REPLACE_ value, template path and null below; gf_portfolio.py lists any still left. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

constraints._help: Total cash (USD) and engineering weeks you can spend across all opportunities.

opportunities._help: One block per idea. Paths are relative to this file. Names must be unique.
opportunities.name: REPLACE_IDEA_NAME
opportunities.decision_comment: Optional. Rankings are always recomputed from the evaluation; a stored decision that disagrees leaves the idea unranked.
opportunities._help_founder_fit: Founder fit 0 to 5, with proof in founder_fit_rationale.

build._help: Cash (USD) and engineering weeks to build the first version.

experiment._help: The next falsifiable test: what you will do, the pass/fail line set in advance, its cost, weeks, and expected learning 0 to 5.

forecast._help: Optional. Each scenario needs buyers, revenue_per_buyer_12m, variable_cost_per_buyer_12m and fixed_cost_12m; leave null to skip.
